whoItsFor: Individual investors and developers who want an LLM-powered daily analysis of a personal watchlist across A-share, Hong Kong, US, Japan, Korean and Taiwan markets, delivered to chat or email channels.
useCases: Automatically analyze a watchlist each day and push the decision dashboard to WeChat Work, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, Slack or email
Run manual analyses, review historical reports and backtests in the local web workbench
Ask multi-turn strategy questions to the built-in agent (moving averages, Chan theory, waves, trends)
